{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment is consistently negative over recent days, indicating bearish momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias when model forecasts deviate significantly from recent 7-14 day average, especially in low volatility regimes.",
    "Increase downward correction magnitude if sentiment is positive but price action shows signs of reversal (e.g., recent highs followed by declines).",
    "Avoid overreacting to single-day sentiment shifts; use 3-5 day sentiment smoothing to filter noise before adjusting forecasts.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is below forecast, reduce next period’s forecast by 5-10% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "When sentiment is positive but price is trending downward, reduce forecast slope to avoid over-optimism.",
    "If model consistently overpredicts in high-sentiment periods, apply a 10-15% downward bias to forecast for the next 3 days."
  ]
}
